visual.general_description: Color photograph of a pale grey young animal with long legs and a long neck lying on its side on a tan sheet on bare ground, with a red-pink oval mass beneath the neck.
visual.detailed_description: The animal has short grey fur, a long neck curved toward the left of the picture, a head with dark eyes at the upper left, and long thin legs extending toward the right and bottom. It lies on a crumpled tan sheet over reddish-brown soil with sparse dry grass. A smooth red-pink oval mass with a few darker spots sits beneath the neck near where the neck meets the body, partly tucked under the neck and body. A person's hand and forearm rest on top of the head at the upper left, and a second hand and forearm rest on the sheet at the lower left. No arrow, ruler, scale bar, panel letter or text is visible.
